payload.reason: The evidence indicates that classification-based models were not used in the zero-shot experiments because they cannot resolve ties in predictions, and regression and ranking approaches provided better performance in the evaluated settings.

claims.text: Classification approaches were not employed in the zero-shot experiments because there is no way to resolve ties with classifier predictions.
Regression and ranking methods outperformed classification in monolingual, within-corpus settings, which influenced the decision to use them instead.
